name: Cheese or Meat Ravioli with Brown Butter
whyItWorks: Refrigerated fresh pasta uses finely milled white flour and smooth filling that digests rapidly.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Boil refrigerated cheese, chicken, or beef ravioli for 4 minutes. Toss in melted browned butter, salt, and grated parmesan (skip acidic tomato marinara during flares).
